utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Klar, ich kann fahren. Sag mir nur, wann du los willst.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ja, ich sag dir gleich Bescheid. Danke dir.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alles klar, dann bis gleich. Schreib mir einfach die Uhrzeit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can probably do the carpool, but I need to know the exact pickup time and how many kids are going.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact pickup time and how many kids there are?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I still need the exact pickup time and the number of kids before I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the carpool. I might’ve missed the latest change—what’s the new plan?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oops, I think the latest plan is to meet at my place at 7, and I’ll drive the second half. Sorry, I keep mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’ll meet there at 7. I’ll keep an eye on the second half.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can handle the carpool plan and repeat it to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late - what time are we leaving for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re leaving in five minutes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’m grabbing my things now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to keep it simple: let’s confirm the pickup time and stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good to me — I’ll keep an ear out and make sure people know the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, then let’s keep that pickup time and make sure everyone hears it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the carpool tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still in for tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, what time should I plan to pick you up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can text the group and make sure everyone knows the carpool plan. What time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m free around 7:30 if that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the carpool. What time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara. Could you take the 8:00 a.m. pickup on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’ll take the 8:00 a.m. pickup on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the list for the carpool if you need me to check anything off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I can check the list with you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s a little different this week, so I’m checking who’s driving when. I’ll let you know as soon as I pin it down.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, just let me know when you’ve got it pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’m on it and I’ll tell you as soon as I know who’s driving.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to confirm, what time were you thinking for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Around 8:00 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: 8:00 works for me too. Does that still give us enough time to get everyone picked up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the carpool. Just send me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, send me the time and place and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What time and place?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll bring it up with the carpool group.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks. Keep me posted if they need anything from me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, I’ll let you know if they need anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the carpool. I might’ve missed the latest change, can you remind me what time we’re doing it now?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s at 7 now. I’ll text you if that changes again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, 7 works for me. Thanks for the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: How about 7:30? That should give us time to get everyone sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me. I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I can keep the carpool organized. What time were you thinking for pickup?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: How about 7:30 AM? That should give us enough time to get everyone there without rushing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: 7:30 AM works for me. I’ll make sure everyone’s ready and on time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could we double-check the pickup times? I want to make sure the carpool stays on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure, let’s keep the pickups tight. I’ll double-check the times and send them over so we stay on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. I’ll wait for your update so I can keep my end lined up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the carpool is still on for tomorrow, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, as far as I know it is. Can you confirm the time?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, I think it’s at 7:30. Can you double-check that with me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep the pickup times fixed and make a simple list. I do better when the plan stays the same.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m good with that. I’ll just add my times to the list and keep to them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, then let’s write them down and leave them as they are.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m a little behind on the updates, but did the carpool time get set?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I can check with the group and get you the time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool. I think I’m on it, unless I already told you a different time and forgot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, I just need the time we agreed on so I can keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think we said 8:15, but I might be mixing it up with another day.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I can handle the morning drop-off on Tuesdays if you can take the afternoon pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, I’ll take the afternoon pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, then I’ll handle the morning drop-off Tuesdays and you’ve got the afternoon pickup.
